global.description: Helm global values (passed by parent charts)

enabled.description: Enable or disable the xks-gateway chart. When enabled, Helm installs or updates the GatewayConfig CRD and manages the gateway namespace, GatewayConfig CR, and OIDC resources. Helm retains an installed CRD as a cluster resource when this chart is disabled or uninstalled.

cleanupOnDisable.description: Delete the release-owned GatewayConfig on upgrade when the gateway is disabled or unconfigured.

cliImage.description: Image containing kubectl and bash for lifecycle hooks

resources.description: Resources for the lifecycle hook Job

imagePullSecretName.description: Optional pull Secret for the GatewayConfig lifecycle Jobs

domain.description: Base DNS domain (e.g., example.com); wildcards are unsupported. The operator adds the subdomain (default rh-ai). Empty disables gateway resources.

ingressMode.description: How the gateway is exposed externally on XKS (LoadBalancer only)

namespace.description: Namespace created by this chart. Must be rh-ai-gateway to match the operator (not configurable).

type.description: TLS strategy: SelfSigned (auto-generated) or Provided (BYO secret in gateway namespace)

secretName.description: Name of TLS Secret (required when type is Provided)

issuerURL.description: OIDC provider URL (e.g., https://keycloak.example.com/realms/rhai). Required at install.

clientID.description: OIDC client ID. Required at install.

oidcClientSecret.description: OIDC client secret for chart-managed Secret (dev/test). Prefer clientSecretRef for production; value is stored in the Helm release Secret.

clientSecretRef.description: Reference to the OIDC client secret (BYO mode) or chart-created secret name (managed mode)

name.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret. Required when oidcClientSecret is not set; defaults to oidc-client-secret when oidcClientSecret is set.

key.description: Key within the Secret that holds the client secret value

secretNamespace.description: Namespace where the client secret is located (defaults to gateway.namespace if empty)

cookie.description: Cookie configuration for OAuth2 proxy sessions

refresh.description: Access token refresh interval — must be less than OIDC provider's Access Token Lifespan

providerCASecretName.description: Name of Secret containing CA cert for the auth provider (must have ca.crt key, in gateway namespace)

verifyProviderCertificate.description: Verify auth provider TLS certificate. Set to false only for development.
